specs.Connector Type: USB Type C, USB Type A

features: Up to an Additional 40* Hours of Battery Life: 10,000 mAh of power fully recharges an iPhone 12 twice, and keeps your smart devices running when an outlet is out of reach.
Versatile Power for 3 Devices at Once: Charge your smartphone and other devices with up to 15W of power from 2 USB-A ports and 1 USB-C port.
Charging Cable Included: A USB-A to USB-C cable is included so you can start charging right out of the box, and it can also be used to recharge the power bank when needed.
LED Indicator Light: An LED light tells you the power bank’s power status, so you always know when it’s time to recharge.
